name: astra-methodology
description: ASTRA (AI-augmented Sprint Through Rapid Assembly) methodology plugin for Korean enterprise software development. Provides Sprint 0 project initialization, Design Thinking-based planning (/service-planner), blueprint authoring (/blueprint), sprint-level isolated worktrees (/sprint-init), integration testing (/test-run), AI-assisted UAT (/user-test, /uat-parallel with vi|en|ko report-language selection), PR merge automation with integration-branch model (/pr-merge), a mostly-unattended full pipeline (/autorun), and a Target-driven convergence loop with adversarial verification (/loop — mandatory max-iteration HITL, frozen rubric, exit at score ≥ 90 with zero P0s or at max iterations). Enforces coding conventions (Java/TypeScript/React Native/Python/CSS/SCSS), the Korean public data standard dictionary, international code standards (ISO 3166-1/2, ITU-T E.164), design system SSoT (DESIGN.md), and quality gates via read-only validator/reviewer/persona agents. Per-version change rationale: docs/development/changelog-v5.md.
